flights-smart-executor.description: FLIGHTS-ONLY — spawned by flights-orchestrator, one fresh executor per task file rated smart: its code and covering tests. Pass the brief file, the task file and its reads paths. flights-orchestrator → here → flights-lander. Returns a DONE, FAILED, SPEC-DRIFT or BLOCKED line, then files changed, the watched-failing test per Done when row, adaptations, RETRO.

general-smart-executor.description: GENERAL-ONLY — spawned by general-orchestrator, one fresh executor per task rated smart: its change and covering test. Pass the inline brief. general-orchestrator → here. Returns a DONE, FAILED, SPEC-DRIFT or BLOCKED line, then files changed, the check line, the watched-failing test, adaptations, RETRO.

heavy-rr.description: Exhaustive rr — delegate for "heavy rr", "heavy-rr X" when the map must settle whatever the cost; lighter → super-rr. Returns the saved RR path, then the cited map.

replace.Spawn at most 4 diggers a round: Spawn at most 8 diggers a round
replace.so 4 diggers carry the entire frontier: so 8 diggers carry the entire frontier
replace.Digging ends when every sub-area is sett: Digging ends when every sub-area is settled, or when a round settled nothing and added no sub-area; no round ceiling applies.

super-rr.description: Deeper rr for higher stakes — delegate for "super rr", "super-rr X"; exhaustive → heavy-rr. Returns the saved RR path, then the cited map.

replace.Spawn at most 4 diggers a round: Spawn at most 6 diggers a round
replace.so 4 diggers carry the entire frontier: so 6 diggers carry the entire frontier
replace.or at the end of round 3 — a safety ceil: or at the end of round 5 — a safety ceiling
